question: How long did it take Emilia to learn Ice Brand Arts?
answer:
After Arc 4 ended and Emilia and Subaru became knight and lord, Subaru and Beatrice started training in magic, doing things like creating a secret training facility.

Seeing this, Emilia thought, “I can't lose to Subaru! I have to work hard too!” She came to him for advice, and the result Subaru came up with was “Ice Brand Arts.”

After that, if we assume she spent time practicing how to create all sorts of weapons from across history and different cultures—by copying their shapes and so on—then I think it probably took about six months before she started producing proper forms.

As everyone knows, Emilia is clumsy, so at first I imagine she was making lots of simple things that were easy to shape, like those little squeaky toy hammers. (laughs)

From there, after continuing to practice, I think it was around six months later that she became capable of creating intricate weapons.
